references.title: The cities this version prices, keyed by `entity.region`: every city-varying parameter (contribution bases and rates, housing-fund limits, minimum wages by zone, the wage base for overtime and leave pay, sick-pay scale, medical period, high-temperature pay, work-injury subsidy months, union-fund schedule and the local filing days) with its sources. Rules read `rules.regions.by_region[company.region]`; an entity whose region is not a row is refused. A new city is a new row.

(terms.monthly_wage - sum(terms.allowances.filter(a, a.code in ["FOREIGN_HOUSING_ALLOWANCE", "FOREIGN_LANGUAGE_ALLOWANCE", "FOREIGN_CHILD_EDUCATION_ALLOWANCE"]).map(a, a.amount))) - ((has(statutory.PENSION) ? statutory.PENSION.employee : 0.0) + (has(earned.month) && has(earned.month.statutory.PENSION) ? earned.month.statutory.PENSION.employee : 0.0) + (has(statutory.MEDICAL) ? statutory.MEDICAL.employee : 0.0) + (has(earned.month) && has(earned.month.statutory.MEDICAL) ? earned.month.statutory.MEDICAL.employee : 0.0) + (has(statutory.UNEMPLOYMENT) ? statutory.UNEMPLOYMENT.employee : 0.0) + (has(earned.month) && has(earned.month.statutory.UNEMPLOYMENT) ? earned.month.statutory.UNEMPLOYMENT.employee : 0.0) + (has(statutory.HPF) ? statutory.HPF.employee : 0.0) + (has(earned.month) && has(earned.month.statutory.HPF) ? earned.month.statutory.HPF.employee : 0.0) + (has(statutory.HPF_SUPPLEMENTARY) ? statutory.HPF_SUPPLEMENTARY.employee : 0.0) + (has(earned.month) && has(earned.month.statutory.HPF_SUPPLEMENTARY) ? earned.month.statutory.HPF_SUPPLEMENTARY.employee : 0.0)) : (terms.monthly_wage - sum(terms.allowances.filter(a, a.code in ["FOREIGN_HOUSING_ALLOWANCE", "FOREIGN_LANGUAGE_ALLOWANCE", "FOREIGN_CHILD_EDUCATION_ALLOWANCE"]).map(a, a.amount))))) < double(rules.regions.by_region[company.region].minimum_wage.zones[(has(company.facts.wage_zone) ? string(company.facts.wage_zone) : rules.regions.by_region[company.region].minimum_wage.default_zone)].amount))
rules.message: the contract wage is below the local monthly minimum wage (Shanghai: after the employee's social insurance and housing fund; Kunming: including them).
rules.description: 最低工资规定 (劳动和社会保障部令第21号) 第十二条: 用人单位支付给劳动者的工资在剔除延长工作时间工资、特殊津贴、法定福利后不得低于当地最低工资标准. SH: 沪人社规〔2025〕10号 — the 2,740 excludes the employee's own social insurance and housing fund contributions, overtime pay and the listed allowances https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgzfl_17732/20250714/t0035_1434097.html. KM: 云人社发〔2025〕19号 三、计算口径 — the minimum wage includes the employee's own social insurance and housing fund https://www.ynjc.gov.cn/u/cms/jcqzfxxgk/202509/30130601xbad.pdf. Checked on a full employed month of a full-time term against the contract monthly wage (`terms.monthly_wage`: base salary and fixed allowances, without the welfare and reimbursement allowances ONLY_CHILD_ALLOWANCE, CHILDCARE_SUBSIDY, TRAVEL_ALLOWANCE and MEAL_SUBSIDY_OUT; the check also leaves out the expatriate housing, language and children-education allowances, as 住房补贴 and reimbursed benefits are not part of the minimum wage — 最低工资规定 第十二条, 沪人社规〔2025〕10号 第三项 伙食补贴、上下班交通费补贴、住房补贴; the high-temperature allowance and overtime are separate lines and never count) and `rules.regions` minimum_wage on the period end; the hourly minimum for part-time work is not checked. The check runs once a month, on the salary run that ends on the month's last day (the last part of a semi-monthly or ten-day month, or the monthly run after a mid-month switch), for an employment covering the whole month, against the month's employee contributions to date (this slip's plus the month's earlier slips', `earned.month`).

rules.when: terms.work_classification in ["STANDARD", ""] && (sum(work.days.filter(d, !((d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"] || d.holiday_kind == "SUBSTITUTE") && d.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && d.holiday_kind != "MAKEUP_WORKDAY") && d.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY").map(d, (d.overtime_hours + d.banked_hours))) + sum(work.days.filter(d, ((d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"] || d.holiday_kind == "SUBSTITUTE") && d.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && d.holiday_kind != "MAKEUP_WORKDAY") || d.holiday_kind == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY").map(d, d.worked_hours))) > 36.0
rules.message: overtime this month exceeds the 36-hour statutory limit.
rules.description: 劳动法 第四十一条: 延长工作时间一般每日不得超过一小时; 因特殊原因需要延长工作时间的, 每日不得超过三小时, 但是每月不得超过三十六小时. Counts the overtime on working days (hours banked as time off included) plus every paid hour on rest days and public holidays (`work.days`). Not applied to approved comprehensive or flexible hours (劳部发〔1994〕503号).

rules.when: terms.work_classification in ["STANDARD", ""] && work.days.exists(d, !((d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"] || d.holiday_kind == "SUBSTITUTE") && d.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && d.holiday_kind != "MAKEUP_WORKDAY") && d.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && (d.overtime_hours + d.banked_hours) > 3.0)
rules.message: a working day carries more than 3 hours of overtime.
rules.description: 劳动法 第四十一条: 因特殊原因需要延长工作时间的, 每日不得超过三小时 (第四十二条 lists the emergencies exempt from the limit).

rules.when: company.region == "SH" && !(terms.employment_type in ["PART_TIME", "INTERN", "RETIREE_REHIRE"])
rules.message: Shanghai unemployment insurance for 2026 is charged at 0.5% / 0.5% by owner ruling, provisional until a 2026 rate notice is published; confirm with the tax bureau.
rules.description: Shanghai 2026 unemployment remains the owner-approved provisional 0.5% employee / 0.5% employer pending a continuing municipal rate notice (沪人社规〔2024〕25号 第一条 ended 2025-12-31). Kunming uses the published current Yunnan split 0.3% employee / 0.7% employer: 元谋县人社局 https://yncxym.gov.cn/info/1011/286437.htm and 龙陵县社会保险中心 https://longling.gov.cn/info/9116/4394209.htm (read 2026-10-09); this warning applies only to SH.

rules.when: (company.region in rules.regions.by_region) && (terms.employment_type == "PART_TIME" && has(terms.facts.hourly_rate) && double(terms.facts.hourly_rate) < double(rules.regions.by_region[company.region].minimum_wage.zones[(has(company.facts.wage_zone) ? string(company.facts.wage_zone) : rules.regions.by_region[company.region].minimum_wage.default_zone)].hourly))
rules.message: the part-time hourly rate is below the local hourly minimum wage.
rules.description: 劳动合同法 第七十二条第一款: 非全日制用工小时计酬标准不得低于用人单位所在地人民政府规定的最低小时工资标准. Customer input: `terms.facts.hourly_rate`. Hourly minimum per `rules.regions` minimum_wage (SH 25; KM 21/20/19, 22/21/20 from 2026-09-01).

rules.when: (has(terms.facts.probation) && terms.facts.probation == true) && (terms.effective_to == "" || terms.effective_to >= add_months(terms.effective_from, int((terms.employment_type in ["PROJECT", "PART_TIME"] || (employment.exit_date == "" ? 999.0 : double(calendar_completed_months(employment.start_date, add_days(employment.exit_date, 1)))) < 3.0 ? 0.0 : ((employment.exit_date == "" ? 999.0 : double(calendar_completed_months(employment.start_date, add_days(employment.exit_date, 1)))) < 12.0 ? 1.0 : ((employment.exit_date == "" ? 999.0 : double(calendar_completed_months(employment.start_date, add_days(employment.exit_date, 1)))) < 36.0 ? 2.0 : 6.0))))))
rules.message: the probation is longer than the contract allows (no probation under 3 months or on a task-based or part-time contract; at most 1 month for under 1 year, 2 months for 1–3 years, 6 months for 3 years or more or open-ended).
rules.description: 劳动合同法 第十九条: 劳动合同期限三个月以上不满一年的, 试用期不得超过一个月; 一年以上不满三年的, 不得超过二个月; 三年以上固定期限和无固定期限的, 不得超过六个月; 以完成一定工作任务为期限或者不满三个月的, 不得约定试用期; 第七十条: 非全日制用工双方当事人不得约定试用期. The probation is a term with `facts.probation`; its length is the term's own range, the contract's the employment range.

rules.when: (company.region in rules.regions.by_region) && ((has(terms.facts.probation) && terms.facts.probation == true) && ((has(terms.facts.contract_wage) && terms.base_salary < 0.8 * double(terms.facts.contract_wage) && !(has(terms.facts.post_lowest_wage) && terms.base_salary >= double(terms.facts.post_lowest_wage))) || (terms.base_salary < double(rules.regions.by_region[company.region].minimum_wage.zones[(has(company.facts.wage_zone) ? string(company.facts.wage_zone) : rules.regions.by_region[company.region].minimum_wage.default_zone)].amount))))
rules.message: the probation wage is below 80% of the agreed contract wage (or the post's lowest level) or below the local minimum wage.
rules.description: 劳动合同法 第二十条: 试用期工资不得低于本单位相同岗位最低档工资或者劳动合同约定工资的百分之八十, 并不得低于用人单位所在地的最低工资标准; 劳动合同法实施条例 第十五条. Facts `contract_wage`, `post_lowest_wage` on the probation term.

rules.when: has(terms.facts.social_insurance_waived) && terms.facts.social_insurance_waived == true
rules.message: an agreement not to pay social insurance is void; social insurance must be paid.
rules.description: 社会保险法 第五十八条、第六十条; 最高人民法院关于审理劳动争议案件适用法律问题的解释（二）(法释〔2025〕12号, 自2025年9月1日) 第十九条: 用人单位与劳动者约定或者劳动者向用人单位承诺无需缴纳社会保险费的, 人民法院应当认定该约定或者承诺无效.

name: Part-time hours (非全日制 4 h a day, 24 h a week)

rules.when: terms.employment_type == "PART_TIME" && ((has(work.days) ? work.days : []).exists(d, d.worked_hours > 4.0) || (has(work.days) ? work.days : []).exists(d, sum((has(work.days) ? work.days : []).filter(x, x.date >= d.date && x.date <= add_days(d.date, 6)).map(x, x.worked_hours)) > 24.0))
rules.message: a part-time employee worked over 4 hours in a day or 24 hours in a week.
rules.description: 劳动合同法 第六十八条: 非全日制用工, 劳动者在同一用人单位一般平均每日工作时间不超过四小时, 每周工作时间累计不超过二十四小时. Weeks are any 7 consecutive days of the roster.

name: Part-time pay cycle at most 15 days

rules.when: terms.employment_type == "PART_TIME" && !(company.pay_frequency in ["SEMI_MONTHLY", "TEN_DAY"])
rules.message: part-time pay must be settled at least every 15 days; this entity pays monthly.
rules.description: 劳动合同法 第七十二条第二款: 非全日制用工劳动报酬结算支付周期最长不得超过十五日; 上海市企业工资支付办法 第二十四条.

name: At least one rest day a week

rules.when: terms.work_classification in ["STANDARD", ""] && (has(work.days) ? work.days : []).exists(d, size((has(work.days) ? work.days : []).filter(x, x.date >= d.date && x.date <= add_days(d.date, 6) && x.worked)) >= 7)
rules.message: the employee worked seven consecutive days without a rest day.
rules.description: 劳动法 第三十八条: 用人单位应当保证劳动者每周至少休息一日; 国务院关于职工工作时间的规定 第七条. Any 7 consecutive worked roster days.

rules.description: 劳动合同法 第四十四条第二项、实施条例 第二十一条 (劳动者达到法定退休年龄的, 劳动合同终止). 全国人民代表大会常务委员会《关于实施渐进式延迟法定退休年龄的决定》(2024年9月13日, 自2025年1月1日) 及《国务院关于渐进式延迟法定退休年龄的办法》第二条: 男职工和原法定退休年龄为五十五周岁的女职工每四个月延迟一个月, 分别逐步延迟至六十三周岁和五十八周岁; 原法定退休年龄为五十周岁的女职工每二个月延迟一个月, 逐步延迟至五十五周岁 https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202409/content_6974294.htm. name: Overtime or night work for a pregnant (7 months+) or nursing employee

rules.when: employee.gender == "FEMALE" && (employee.children.exists(c, has(c.estimated_delivery_date) && c.estimated_delivery_date != "" && (!has(c.child_birthdate) || c.child_birthdate == "") && c.estimated_delivery_date >= period.from && add_days(c.estimated_delivery_date, -84) <= period.to) || employee.children.exists(c, has(c.child_birthdate) && c.child_birthdate != "" && add_years(c.child_birthdate, 1) > period.from)) && ((has(work.days) ? work.days : []).exists(d, (d.overtime_hours + d.banked_hours) > 0.0) || (has(work.days) ? work.days : []).exists(d, hours_between(d.intervals, "22:00", "06:00") > 0.0))
rules.message: a pregnant employee from her 7th month, or a nursing employee with a child under 1, must not work overtime or nights.
rules.description: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 第六条第二款 (怀孕7个月以上的女职工, 用人单位不得延长劳动时间或者安排夜班劳动), 第九条第一款 (对哺乳未满1周岁婴儿的女职工, 不得延长劳动时间或者安排夜班劳动); 上海市女职工劳动保护办法 第十二条. Night is 22:00–06:00 on the roster intervals.

name: Wages paid after the agreed pay day

rules.when: has(company.facts.wage_payday) && period.pay_date != "" && period.pay_date > (add_days(add_months(month_start(period.from), has(company.facts.wage_payday_month_offset) ? int(company.facts.wage_payday_month_offset) : 0), int(company.facts.wage_payday) - 1) < month_end(add_months(month_start(period.from), has(company.facts.wage_payday_month_offset) ? int(company.facts.wage_payday_month_offset) : 0)) ? add_days(add_months(month_start(period.from), has(company.facts.wage_payday_month_offset) ? int(company.facts.wage_payday_month_offset) : 0), int(company.facts.wage_payday) - 1) : month_end(add_months(month_start(period.from), has(company.facts.wage_payday_month_offset) ? int(company.facts.wage_payday_month_offset) : 0)))
rules.message: wages are paid after the agreed pay day (pay early when it falls on a holiday or rest day).
rules.description: 工资支付暂行规定 第七条: 工资必须在用人单位与劳动者约定的日期支付; 如遇节假日或休息日, 则应提前在最近的工作日支付; 工资至少每月支付一次. SH: 上海市企业工资支付办法 (沪人社规〔2026〕10号) 第六条; KM: 昆明市工资支付条例 第十条. Entity facts `wage_payday` (day of month) and `wage_payday_month_offset` (0 the same month, 1 the next).

name: More than 3 hours of overtime on a working day

rules.when: terms.work_classification in ["STANDARD", ""] && !((day.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"] || day.holiday_kind == "SUBSTITUTE") && day.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && day.holiday_kind != "MAKEUP_WORKDAY") && day.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && (day.overtime_hours + day.banked_hours) > 3.0
rules.message: more than 3 hours of overtime on a working day.
rules.description: 劳动法 第四十一条: 延长工作时间每日不得超过三小时 (第四十二条 exempts emergencies, so the day is recorded and warned) https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html

name: Planned shift over 8 hours: the excess is not paid as overtime

rules.when: terms.work_classification in ["STANDARD", ""] && day.worked && !((day.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"] || day.holiday_kind == "SUBSTITUTE") && day.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && day.holiday_kind != "MAKEUP_WORKDAY") && day.holiday_kind != "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && day.scheduled_hours > 8.0
rules.message: the planned shift has more than 8 ordinary hours: the hours past 8 are not paid as overtime.
rules.description: 国务院关于职工工作时间的规定 第三条: 职工每日工作8小时、每周工作40小时; 劳动法 第四十四条: hours beyond it are paid overtime. Overtime is the time past the planned shift's ordinary hours, so a standard-hours shift planned over 8 hours leaves statutory overtime unpaid https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html

name: Seven consecutive worked days without a rest day

rules.when: terms.work_classification in ["STANDARD", ""] && day.worked && week.worked_days >= 7
rules.message: seven consecutive worked days without a rest day.
rules.description: 劳动法 第三十八条: 用人单位应当保证劳动者每周至少休息一日 https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html

name: A part-time employee worked over 24 hours in seven days

rules.when: terms.employment_type == "PART_TIME" && week.worked_hours > 24.0
rules.message: a part-time employee worked over 24 hours in seven days.
rules.description: 劳动合同法 第六十八条: 非全日制用工每周工作时间累计不超过二十四小时 https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html

name: Overtime or night work for an employee 7+ months pregnant or nursing an infant under 1

rules.when: employee.gender == "FEMALE" && (employee.children.exists(c, has(c.estimated_delivery_date) && c.estimated_delivery_date != "" && (!has(c.child_birthdate) || c.child_birthdate == "") && day.date <= c.estimated_delivery_date && day.date >= add_days(c.estimated_delivery_date, -84)) || employee.children.exists(c, has(c.child_birthdate) && c.child_birthdate != "" && day.date < add_years(c.child_birthdate, 1))) && ((day.overtime_hours + day.banked_hours) > 0.0 || hours_between(day.intervals, "22:00", "06:00") > 0.0)

name: A person under 16 may not be employed (劳动法 第十五条); record the approval of an arts, sports or special-crafts unit if it applies

rules.when: day.worked && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day.date) < 16 && !(has(employee.facts.minor_employment_approved) && employee.facts.minor_employment_approved == true)
rules.message: a person under 16 may not be employed (劳动法 第十五条); record the approval of an arts, sports or special-crafts unit if it applies.
rules.description: 劳动法 第十五条: 禁止用人单位招用未满十六周岁的未成年人; 文艺、体育和特种工艺单位须履行审批手续; 第九十四条 https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html

rules.when: (has(term.facts) && has(term.facts.probation) && term.facts.probation == true) && (employment.terms.exists(t, has(t.facts) && has(t.facts.probation) && t.facts.probation == true && !(has(t.effective_range.to) && t.effective_range.to != null && add_days(string(t.effective_range.to), 1) == term.effective_from) && !(term.effective_to != "" && add_days(term.effective_to, 1) == string(t.effective_range.from))) || person.contracts.exists(c, (has(c.facts.probation) && c.facts.probation == true) || (has(c.terms) && c.terms.exists(t, has(t.facts.probation) && t.facts.probation == true))))
rules.message: only one probation may be agreed with the same employee (劳动合同法 第十九条第二款): this employment or an earlier contract with this employer already has one.
rules.description: 劳动合同法 第十九条第二款: 同一用人单位与同一劳动者只能约定一次试用期 https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html. Reads employment.terms[] (a probation term continued by an adjoining one is the same probation) and person.contracts[] (every term of each earlier contract, its first included).

rules.when: term.employment_type == "FIXED_TERM" && term.effective_from == employment.start_date && !(has(term.facts.employee_requested_fixed_term) && term.facts.employee_requested_fixed_term == true) && (employment.service_months >= 120.0 || (size(person.contracts) >= 2 && person.contracts[size(person.contracts) - 1].contract_type == "FIXED_TERM" && person.contracts[size(person.contracts) - 2].contract_type == "FIXED_TERM" && person.contracts[size(person.contracts) - 1].end != "" && add_days(person.contracts[size(person.contracts) - 1].end, 1) == employment.start_date && person.contracts[size(person.contracts) - 2].end != "" && add_days(person.contracts[size(person.contracts) - 2].end, 1) == person.contracts[size(person.contracts) - 1].start))
rules.message: an open-ended contract must be concluded (劳动合同法 第十四条第二款): 10 years of continuous service, or two consecutive fixed-term contracts before this one; record term fact employee_requested_fixed_term if the employee asked for a fixed term.
rules.description: 劳动合同法 第十四条第二款第(一)项 (连续工作满十年) and 第(三)项 (连续订立二次固定期限劳动合同后续订): 劳动者提出或者同意续订、订立劳动合同的, 除劳动者提出订立固定期限劳动合同外, 应当订立无固定期限劳动合同 https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html. A new contract's first FIXED_TERM term is refused unless the employee asked for a fixed term; consecutive = each earlier contract ended the day before the next started (person.contracts[]). The 第三十九条 / 第四十条(一)(二) exceptions are grounds to end, not to renew, so they are not modelled.

rules.when: (has(work.days) ? work.days : []).exists(d, d.suspended != null && d.suspended.kind in ["STOPPAGE_EMPLOYER", "FORCE_MAJEURE", "GOVERNMENT_ORDER"] && !d.worked && d.day_type == "WORK" && d.date >= add_months(d.suspended.from, 1) && !has(d.suspended.facts.living_allowance_daily))
rules.message: a stoppage day after the first pay cycle was not worked and the suspension records no living allowance (living_allowance_daily): it paid 0; record the employer's rules or contract standard.
rules.description: 工资支付暂行规定 第十二条; 人社厅明电〔2020〕5号 二 (生活费标准按各省规定的办法执行); 云南省人社厅 政策解答 四 (the employer's rules or contract set the standard). A missing amount is a data gap, not a lawful 0.

references.title: 全国年节及纪念日放假办法 (国务院令第795号修订, 自2025年1月1日) 第二条: 元旦1天, 春节4天 (农历除夕、正月初一至初三), 清明节1天, 劳动节2天 (5月1日、2日), 端午节1天, 中秋节1天, 国庆节3天 (10月1日至3日) — PUBLIC_HOLIDAY; 第三条: 妇女节妇女放假半天, 青年节14周岁以上的青年放假半天, 建军节现役军人放假半天 (适逢周六、周日不补假) — SPECIAL_HOLIDAY (ordinary time if worked) https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/202411/content_6986380.htm; 国务院办公厅关于2026年部分节假日安排的通知 (国办发明电〔2025〕7号, 2025年11月4日): 元旦1月1日至3日放假, 1月4日上班; 春节2月15日至23日放假, 2月14日、2月28日上班; 清明4月4日至6日; 劳动节5月1日至5日, 5月9日上班; 端午6月19日至21日; 中秋9月25日至27日; 国庆10月1日至7日, 9月20日、10月10日上班 https://www.news.cn/politics/20251104/88bcffd88ae249e58c699b8772548e3d/c.html. name: 个人所得税扣缴申报表 (IIT withholding return)

references.title: 个人所得税扣缴申报表 and 填表说明 (国家税务总局公告2019年第7号 附件2, 40 columns), read 2026-10-07

rules.description: One numbered row (序号) per employee for the withholding return: select the year's runs through the month filed — the month columns read the last slip, the cumulative columns the selection. Special additional deductions (columns 25–29) and the computed columns 31–35 are left to the tax client, which holds the declarations.
rules.file: "个人所得税扣缴申报表-" + runs[size(runs) - 1].period + ".csv"
rules.when: has(totals.statutory.IIT) && size(slips) > 0

columns.value: (employee.nationality == null || employee.nationality == "" || employee.nationality == "CN") ? "居民身份证" : "护照"

(has(employee.facts) && employee.facts != null && has(employee.facts.employment_statutory_facts) && employee.facts.employment_statutory_facts.exists(f, has(f.status) && has(f.status.elections) && has(f.status.elections.prior_year_60000) && f.status.elections.prior_year_60000 == true)) ? (slips[size(slips) - 1].period.substring(5, 7) == "01" ? 60000.0 : 0.0) : 5000.0

("HPF" in slips[size(slips) - 1].statutory ? slips[size(slips) - 1].statutory.HPF.employee : 0.0) + ("HPF_SUPPLEMENTARY" in slips[size(slips) - 1].statutory ? slips[size(slips) - 1].statutory.HPF_SUPPLEMENTARY.employee : 0.0)

(has(employee.facts) && employee.facts != null && has(employee.facts.employment_statutory_facts) && employee.facts.employment_statutory_facts.exists(f, has(f.status) && has(f.status.elections) && has(f.status.elections.prior_year_60000) && f.status.elections.prior_year_60000 == true)) ? 60000.0 : 5000.0 * double(size(slips))

("PENSION" in totals.statutory ? totals.statutory.PENSION.employee : 0.0) + ("MEDICAL" in totals.statutory ? totals.statutory.MEDICAL.employee : 0.0) + ("UNEMPLOYMENT" in totals.statutory ? totals.statutory.UNEMPLOYMENT.employee : 0.0) + ("HPF" in totals.statutory ? totals.statutory.HPF.employee : 0.0) + ("HPF_SUPPLEMENTARY" in totals.statutory ? totals.statutory.HPF_SUPPLEMENTARY.employee : 0.0)
("IIT" in totals.statutory ? totals.statutory.IIT.employee : 0.0) - ("IIT" in slips[size(slips) - 1].statutory ? slips[size(slips) - 1].statutory.IIT.employee : 0.0)
